title: Insight editor auto-saves (PATCH) on chart-type change without clicking Save
answers: insight editor saves and exits edit mode when I pick a chart type
'Insight updated' toast appears after changing chart type without clicking Save
persistDisplayOptions sends PATCH unexpectedly in the insight scene
body:
Symptom: In the insight editor, selecting a new chart type immediately saves the insight, exits edit mode and shows "Insight updated" without the user clicking Save. Race condition, hard to reproduce, seen right after opening the editor.
Root cause: frontend/src/scenes/insights/insightDataLogic.tsx:isInsightSceneInstance compared against insightSceneLogic's insightLogicRef, which is set by a separate async listener (rebuilds and mounts a new logic). It can lag, so the guard let persistDisplayOptions PATCH through.
Fix pattern: Guard on synchronously-set reducers (insightId, dashboardId in insightSceneLogic, written by the same action that matches the URL) rather than on values derived by listener side effects.
Constraints: Compare dashboardId with null-normalisation (?? null on both sides). Applies to any 'are we in the insight scene for these props' guard; do not reintroduce insightLogicRef there.
applies: frontend/src/scenes/insights/insightDataLogic.tsx guards that decide whether to skip auto-persisting
